card.name: Punctuation before growth-factor or biochemical terms
card.fires_on: Commas, linking words and number spaces in biomedical text where a biochemical name such as a cytokine, growth factor or enzyme is likely to come next. Also the space after 'Vol.' or 'No.' in journal citations.
